prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference is first-tier design family 1. Create DARK stage 10 of ten, for 90 learning-streak days. Preserve design identity, near-frontal camera, premium mature matte graphite clay #303036 and soft top-left light. Late-stage evolution: Upright central flame, two large shoulder tongues and lower flowing lobes, organic full body; a neutral relief border around cyan inner flame. Progression level 10: fuller body, central tongue taller, curling tip more pronounced than the early reference, broad readable silhouette; retain at most six broad lobes. Shape must stay recognizably in same family. Single cyan #00ffff inset remains on SAME reference detail, 2–5 percent of square canvas; neutral bevel and NO cyan elsewhere. Real transparent alpha background, clear hollow holes, no stray white fragments or specks, no checkerboard, floor or cast shadow. Square1024, centered, 8 percent margin, no cropping. No text, digits, crown, tower, jewels, metal, glass, particles, realistic fire, childish toy or face.
